response.justification: The candidate is a strong generalist engineer with deep web, backend, and DLang experience, but he does not meet the core requirements: his professional C++ experience is limited to roughly six months at National Instruments over a decade ago, and he has no demonstrated Fixed Income, Capital Markets, or Investment Banking domain expertise. His SQL exposure appears to be MySQL/MongoDB rather than SQL Server/Oracle, and there is no evidence of Windows-platform development focus.
strengths: Solid low-latency, high-performance systems experience (DLang, async I/O at Sociomantic)
Strong engineering practices: TDD, CI/CD, DevOps, and open-source contributions
Broad technical versatility including Java, scripting, and messaging-adjacent architectures
concerns: Far short of the mandatory 5–10 years of hands-on C++ on Windows
No Fixed Income, derivatives, or capital-markets domain experience
No SQL Server or Oracle experience; database background is MongoDB/MySQL

key_factors.factor: Strong systems programming and engineering fundamentals
